_note: Episode 41 (Season 4 finale) keyframes (from Kabanata 41, story version 2). 1935: the Commonwealth inauguration seen from the edge of a huge crowd before a neoclassical building; Quezon only a tiny far figure, no likeness, no words. The new bronze marker and all text are unreadable. The dragon is a mythic red serpent-dragon in storm clouds spewing water; God is never shown; the other light is only light. No real seals, flags of office or logos. Indio is 42. Copied from Episode 13: full intro. Shots follow sentences.json; k90+ are montage extras.
